verification.notes: A fired TPUSA contractor publicly alleged she was terminated over a statement attributed to an Uber driver, which gives limited support to one element of the accusation. records.text: A person described as being in Andrew Kolvet's inner circle said Kolvet, Turning Point USA's in-house lawyer, and chief marketing officer Marina Minas were headed to the White House that day.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep HZvwbfePe7o)

appearances.snippet: My source was pretty solid. I will say that I said received a tip from someone in Andrew (Andrew Kolvet)'s inner circle that he, along with Turning Point in-house lawyer, plus the CMO Marina Minas are headed to the White House today.

verification.notes: Transcript context at 00:32:20 was reviewed. The claim came from an unnamed person described as being in Kolvet's inner circle. Contemporary reporting records Kolvet's categorical denial and states that neither side supplied independent evidence and no independent confirmation of a White House visit existed. The anonymous tip therefore remains unverifiable.

Also, I have learned, and this is quite unusual because he does not often travel. verification.notes: Transcript context shows Owens attributed the scheduling claim to an unnamed White House employee. Live searches located repetitions of the episode but no White House calendar, attendee confirmation, original correspondence, or independent reporting that establishes the proposed meeting and all four participants. The private-source claim therefore remains attempted/unverifiable rather than false.

records.text: Current and former Turning Point USA employees told Owens that Erika Kirk was in the office every day and making informed decisions alongside Stacy Sheridan and Marina Minas.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep QdM9jLwjwLw)

appearances.snippet: after she got caught red-handed and everything i'm learning from the employees right now like she was very much involved in a lot of the pr stuff she i assumed everyone was just doing things and she was gathering herself and she was like at home in the ... home in the fetal condition nope she was in the office every day and she was making informed decisions alongside Stacy Sheridan and this Marina Minas

verification.notes: The source appearance is explicitly an anonymous/read-message account conveyed by Owens. External episode transcripts preserve Owens's claim that employees said Erika Kirk was in the office daily and involved with Stacy Sheridan and Marina Minas. TPUSA's official team page confirms Erika Kirk's leadership role, Sheridan's development role, and Minas's marketing and public-relations responsibilities, but it does not corroborate daily presence or joint decision-making. No named employee, attendance record, meeting record, or direct confirmation was found, so the claim is attempted/unverifiable.
